specification.outcome: Exact published EDC G38 All Students math/ELA regular-assessment rates only; SEA-native provenance must be audited.
specification.income: Reported CCD direct-certification Education Unit Total divided by Reported positive same-year CCD Membership Education Unit Total, via exact 12-digit NCES school ID.
specification.scope: Grade schools only, using same-year directory GSHI<=08, excluding grade13/adult offers; separate state/subject cohorts.
specification.intervals: Unavailable: never use constructed level counts, enrollment proxies or unchecked tested values.
specification.missingness: Exclude ranges, suppression, missing or nonreported flags; never zero-fill. No FRPL fallback.
specification.limitations: DC is a benefits-based proxy with state variation and incomplete reporting coverage, not full FRPL or a common national income definition.
